info.title: Site2Ad (Adsify) API
info.summary: Turn a business website, or your own media, into a short video ad.
info.description:
Scan a website, upload media, create ONE video ad in the background and download the MP4.

**Long-running work is asynchronous.** `POST /api/scrape` and `POST /api/generate-ad` answer `202 Accepted` at once; poll `GET /api/jobs/{job_id}` and `GET /api/ads/{ad_id}` until the job is final.

**Authentication:** none. The API has no login; protect a public deployment with your own gateway (see docs/API.md). Requests that cost money are limited per client (`RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE`) and per day (`MAX_ADS_PER_DAY`).

**Errors** always use the body `{"detail": "plain-language message", "code": "machine_code"}`.

post.description: Start scanning a website. Poll GET /api/jobs/{job_id} for progress.

429.description: `rate_limited` (too many requests from this client per minute).

500.description: `internal_error` (unexpected server error; details are logged, never returned).

get.description: Progress and result of a website scan.

500.description: `internal_error` (unexpected server error; details are logged, never returned).

post.description: Multipart upload. Images are decoded and re-encoded (EXIF and hidden data removed); videos are identified from their bytes and checked with ffprobe (H.264, H.265, VP8, VP9, AV1; length and size limits). All files of one request are stored or none (all or nothing).

500.description: `internal_error` (unexpected server error; details are logged, never returned).

get.description: An uploaded image or video (for previews). The type comes from the stored file, never from the uploader.

200.description: The stored file. The media type comes from the stored file, never from the uploader.

500.description: `internal_error` (unexpected server error; details are logged, never returned).

post.description: Create ONE ad (one prompt, one video). Poll GET /api/ads/{ad_id}.

website.summary: Auto ad from a scan: original website images (no AI video)

ai.summary: Auto ad with AI-generated footage (needs a configured video provider)

manual.summary: Manual ad from uploaded media (FFmpeg only, no scan, no AI)

404.description: `job_not_found` (the scan in `job_id` does not exist or expired).

409.description: `scan_not_ready` (the scan has no first result yet).

422.description: `invalid_request` (contradictory or invalid fields), `business_name_required`, `ai_video_unavailable` (AI modes without a configured video provider), `no_images`, `unknown_image`, `asset_not_found`, `bad_media` or `invalid_creative`.

500.description: `internal_error` (unexpected server error; details are logged, never returned).

get.description: Progress, prompt and result of an ad.

500.description: `internal_error` (unexpected server error; details are logged, never returned).

post.description: Stop an ad that is still being made (it ends as failed with a 'cancelled' message).

500.description: `internal_error` (unexpected server error; details are logged, never returned).

get.description: The finished MP4 (supports Range requests so players can seek).

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: Optional byte range, e.g. `bytes=0-1048575` (players use it to seek).

200.description: The whole MP4. With `download=true` it is sent as an attachment.

500.description: `internal_error` (unexpected server error; details are logged, never returned).

206.description: The requested byte range of the MP4.

416.description: The Range header cannot be satisfied (no body).

get.description: What this server can do (options, limits, demo mode).

500.description: `internal_error` (unexpected server error; details are logged, never returned).

get.description: Readiness: database, cache, browser and video provider status. Answers 503 when the database is down.

AdBrief.title: AdBrief
AdBrief.description:
The validated plan between the facts and the video prompt: what the ad says, shows and puts on screen.

Only facts from the FactSheet appear in `supporting_facts`, `cta` and `overlay_text`; missing facts are listed in
`missing` instead of being invented, and claims about other businesses are listed in `rejected_claims`.

AdOptions.title: AdOptions
AdOptions.description: Creative options for ONE ad. For another ad, call the pipeline again with different options.

AdPrompt.title: AdPrompt
AdPrompt.description: The ONE video prompt for ONE ad, plus its negative prompt.

AdResponse.title: AdResponse
AdResponse.description: Body of GET /api/ads/{ad_id} and the response of POST /api/generate-ad.

AssetInfo.title: AssetInfo
AssetInfo.description: A user uploaded image or video.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: logo: one image (PNG kept). photo: JPG/PNG/WebP, re-encoded. video: MP4/MOV/WebM, checked with ffprobe.

files.title: Files
files.description: One or more files (one for a logo). Limits come from GET /api/config.

BriefConcept.title: BriefConcept
BriefConcept.description: One creative concept: a visual idea and the scene(s) that film it.

BriefFact.title: BriefFact
BriefFact.description: One supporting fact in an ad brief, with where it came from.

BusinessOverrides.title: BusinessOverrides
BusinessOverrides.description: Facts typed by the user. They win over scraped facts and count as verified.

CompositionSegment.title: CompositionSegment
CompositionSegment.description: One part of the finished video, in order: what it is, where it came from, how long it plays.

ConfigResponse.title: ConfigResponse
ConfigResponse.description: Body of GET /api/config: what this deployment can do, so the UI never hard-codes it.

Contacts.title: Contacts
Contacts.description: Other contact channels found on the page.

CreativeConfig.title: CreativeConfig
CreativeConfig.description:
How ONE ad is made. The backend validates every combination; the browser never decides alone what runs.

manual          -> your uploaded images/videos, FFmpeg only (no scan, no prompt writer, no AI video)
auto + website  -> original website images, FFmpeg only (no AI video, no prompt writer)
auto + ai       -> website facts -> ONE prompt -> AI text-to-video (no website images) -> loop to length -> finalize
auto + mixed    -> website image(s) -> AI video -> website image(s), composed with FFmpeg

CreativeModeInfo.title: CreativeModeInfo
CreativeModeInfo.description: One way of making an ad, as offered by GET /api/config (the UI lists these instead of hard-coding them).

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description: Error body used by every non-2xx response.

GenerateAdRequest.title: GenerateAdRequest
GenerateAdRequest.description:
Body of POST /api/generate-ad. Provide a scrape job_id, a scrape_result, or manual business details.

Without `creative` the original one-prompt / one-hero AI flow runs unchanged (kept for older clients).

HeroRef.title: HeroRef
HeroRef.description: Which ONE image becomes the first frame of the video.

JobResponse.title: JobResponse
JobResponse.description: Body of GET /api/jobs/{job_id} and the response of POST /api/scrape.

PageInfo.title: PageInfo
PageInfo.description: A secondary page read during phase 2.

Phase2Info.title: Phase2Info
Phase2Info.description: Progress of the background crawl of extra pages.

Phone.title: Phone
Phone.description: One phone number candidate with where it was found.

ReferenceImage.title: ReferenceImage
ReferenceImage.description: The hero image sent to the video model together with the prompt.

ScrapeResult.title: ScrapeResult
ScrapeResult.description: Everything the scraper returns. It is always returned, never raised.

SiteInfo.title: SiteInfo
SiteInfo.description: Business facts and metadata taken from the website.
